## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home is built and lives in its own private repo, `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`. It has a compose setup built from source (works on arm64 and amd64), a broken alert rule, a connection leak, an over-broad IAM policy, and a 3-hour time box. The rubric is written with no cut-off. `hiring/` was removed from the infra branch (uncommitted), and no PR was opened.

- [prochaine-étape] Maya sends the exercise and a repo invite to the candidate herself after Thursday's call.
- [prochaine-étape] Drop the `maya/sre-take-home` branch in infra later.
- [essai-raté] A multi-arch `buildx --load` build fails because the docker exporter can't load manifest lists, so the image is no longer prebuilt.
- [décision] Take-home limited to 3 hours, Terraform and compose only, no Kubernetes. (source: t03)
- [décision] Compose builds `flaky-svc` from source, with no prebuilt image. (source: t06)
- [décision] Rubric scores are input for the panel, not a threshold. Noa is the second reviewer. (source: t10)
- [décision] No email is sent to anyone; Maya sends it herself after the call. (source: t16)
